text:
zoe: Quick sync re: roles panel and invite UX after the console walkthrough. Main asks: 1) audit log jump and keyboard landmarks, 2) clearer invite failure surface, 3) SSO enforcement modal copy. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/roles-invite-a11y
liam: On audit log navigation - keyboard users can't jump directly to an event from the role detail. We need a 'Jump to audit' button that focuses the log list and applies a filter for that role. Also add aria-controls/aria-describedby so screen readers know the relationship.
devon: For invite failures, current behavior is a single error line under email input. That doesn't scale for CSV bulk invites. Suggest a persistent inline 'Invite errors' panel that lists rows (email + reason) and a 'Copy CSV' + 'Retry' action. Keep it keyboard accessible and focusable.
kara: Small copy point: SSO enforcement modal currently says 'Enforce SSO across the org' which some PMs think sounds punitive. Alternatives: 'Require Single Sign-On (SSO) for all members' or 'Require SSO to access the org'. Which reads clearer?
liam: I prefer 'Require SSO to access the org'  - it's shorter and matches other admin copy. Add inline helper link 'How this affects invites' that opens the modal docs.
accessibility-bot: A11y scan for /console/org-settings returned: focus-order issues (2), missing aria-describedby on jump links (1), contrast warnings on microcopy. See: https://a11y-reports.internal/1765599
zoe: UX note on role inheritance UI: when a role is inherited from a team, we show a small chain icon but no textual affordance. Suggest showing 'Inherited from Team: Billing' text for SR users and a tooltip for sighted users.
devon: Also edge-case: invited user who already has SSO via IdP. Current flow denies invite if 'Require SSO' is on. We need a clearer error: 'User exists with enforced SSO. Send SSO-enabled invite or add via SCIM.' And a link to docs.
kara: Keyboard trapping bug: when opening role detail panel, tab stops inside but SHIFT+TAB doesn't return to main list. Repro steps attached: open panel -> press tab until end -> shift+tab stuck. Proposed fix: maintain roving tabindex in list and ensure panel close returns focus to originating list item.
liam: Quick ARIA example for 'Jump to audit' button:\n\n<button aria-controls=\"audit-list\" aria-describedby=\"audit-help\">Jump to audit for Billing Admin< /button>\n<div id=\"audit-help\">Focuses audit log and filters events for the selected role.< /div>\n\nThis gives screen readers context.
design-bot: Suggested microcopy for invite error panel header: 'Invite errors (2)' and subtext 'Rows with issues are listed below. You can copy reasons or retry failed invites.'
accessibility-bot: Reminder: When adding 'Inherited from' text, ensure color contrast meets AA and that the text is programmatically determinable (avoid only icon conveyance). Run scan after changes.
zoe: I'll update Figma with: 44px tap target for chain icon, inherited text visible to SR, 'Jump to audit' primary action, and the persistent invite errors panel. Posting frames by lunchtime.
devon: I'll prototype the persistent panel and CSV copy action; will include keyboard flows and Esc behavior to close and return focus to email input.
liam: I'll wire aria-controls and add descriptive text for Jump action and test with NVDA/VoiceOver. Will report back with short test log.
zoe: Thanks! We'll review the mocks in tomorrow's product/eng sync. If anyone sees related audit filter edge-cases (service accounts, SCIM events), drop them here.
